column7:
Reduction in provision
by re-appropriation of
₹4,500.00 lakh was
attributed to
anticipated saving.
Final excess of ₹5.69
lakh is overstated by
₹34.51 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹28.82 lakh.
Reasons for surrender
of ₹2,500.00 lakh as
well as actual saving
have not been
intimated (July 2024).
